symptom: memory_cycle.assess_human_interaction_efficiency reported 100% efficiency and 0% avoidable rate when no human actions occurred, while the canonical Human Interaction control reports zero-denominator metrics as NOT_EXERCISED.
root_cause: The earlier Memory Cycle pilot predated the canonical zero-denominator semantics and retained optimistic defaults for empty event sets.
early_signals: tools/landscape/memory_cycle.py returned 100.0 for the same denominator
SCN-040 established that zero denominator is not evidence of 100% completion
human_cost: No direct human action was required, but the metric could overstate autonomy quality and contaminate executive reporting.
prevention_rule: All zero-denominator Human Interaction Efficiency calculations must return NOT_EXERCISED / null percentages rather than 100%.
automated_detection: SCN-048 integrated compound-failure test and test_landscape_memory_cycle zero-human-action regression.
